basic_details.job_title: CURAJ Sports Coach Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central University of Rajasthan (राजस्थान केन्द्रीय विश्वविद्यालय) is inviting online applications for 8 posts of Sports Coaches, one each in Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Boxing, Table Tennis and Wushu. The posts are purely on contractual basis for a period of one year or till further orders, whichever is earlier, at a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 55,000/-. The online application closes on 21 November 2026 (11:59 PM), and the hard copy with self-attested documents must reach the University by 26 November 2026 (05:00 PM).

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified (schedule to be published on the university website)

how_to_apply: Applications are made online in the prescribed format, and a hard copy is then sent by post. The notice says the prescribed application form, the essential qualifications, the experience details and other particulars are on the University website, www.curaj.ac.in.
Get the prescribed application form and the post details from the University website, www.curaj.ac.in.
Submit the online application in the prescribed format by 21 November 2026 (11:59 PM).
Attach self-attested copies of all the required documents to the hard copy of the application form.
Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of ……………… [Name of Post] (on contract basis)", filling in the post you are applying for, for example Sports Coach (Football).
Send the envelope to: Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Central University of Rajasthan, NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, Distt – Ajmer (Raj.), PIN – 305817.
Make sure the hard copy reaches the University by 26 November 2026 (05:00 PM). Applications received after the last date will not be considered and are liable to be summarily rejected.
Hard copy of the application form submitted online
Self-attested copies of all the required documents (supporting documents)
important_instructions: The selected candidate must do any other duties and work that the Central University of Rajasthan assigns from time to time. If the University finds during the engagement that academic credentials, age or experience are without standing, fake or substandard, or that documents are false, fabricated, manufactured or tampered with, the engagement will be ended at once. The same applies if the candidate is found ineligible under the prescribed educational qualifications and experience. Action will also be taken against the candidate as per rules. Any dispute, suit or legal proceeding against the University falls only under the jurisdiction of the Rajasthan High Court Bench Jaipur.

content_sections.heading: About CURAJ
content_sections.text: Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) is a central university at NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, in Ajmer district, Rajasthan. Its letterhead states that it has Category-I University status from the UGC. The Registrar issued this recruitment through the University's Recruitment Cell.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 8 Sports Coach vacancies in total, one in each of eight sports disciplines. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All eight Sports Coach posts have the same essential and desirable qualifications. For each post, the qualification and experience must be in that post's own sport. Candidates are responsible for checking their own eligibility for the post they apply for. The notice does not mention an age limit for these posts. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

rows.post: Sports Coaches (Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Boxing, Table Tennis, Wushu)
rows.essential_qualification: One-year Diploma/PG Diploma in Sports Coaching in the concerned sports discipline from a recognized institute/ university in India or abroad, along with a minimum of 02 years of coaching experience in the concerned sport in a reputed institution/organization.
rows.desirable: Master's in Sports Coaching OR M.P.Ed.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Sports Coaches are eligible for a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 55,000/- per month. However, the salary will be commensurate to the qualification and experience of the candidates. The appointment is purely on contractual basis, for a period of one year or till further orders, whichever is earlier. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits that are admissible to the regular employees of the Central University of Rajasthan. The engagement does not give any right to claim a regular appointment in the University or continued service in the University. When the engagement period in the offer ends, the candidate will not need to report for duty unless the University gives a further extension. The University reserves the right to end the engagement at any time, even before the stipulated period, for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any other administrative reasons/compulsions.

Attach self-attested copies of all the required documents to the hard copy of the application form. Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of ……………… [Name of Post] (on contract basis)", filling in the post you are applying for, for example Sports Coach (Football). Send the envelope to: Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Central University of Rajasthan, NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, Distt – Ajmer (Raj.), PIN – 305817. Make sure the hard copy reaches the University by 26 November 2026 (05:00 PM). Applications received after the last date will not be considered and are liable to be summarily rejected. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the University for an interview on the prescribed date and time. The University will publish the interview schedule separately on its website, www.curaj.ac.in. If any dispute or ambiguity arises in the selection process, the University's decision is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 Sports Coach vacancies, one each in Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Boxing, Table Tennis and Wushu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CURAJ Sports Coach posts?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 21 November 2026 (11:59 PM). The hard copy of the application form with all supporting documents must reach the University by 26 November 2026 (05:00 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CURAJ Sports Coach posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a One-year Diploma/PG Diploma in Sports Coaching in the concerned sports discipline from a recognized institute/university in India or abroad. They also need a minimum of 02 years of coaching experience in the concerned sport in a reputed institution/organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the desirable qualification for a CURAJ Sports Coach?
faq.answer: The desirable qualification is a Master's in Sports Coaching OR M.P.Ed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a CURAJ Sports Coach?
faq.answer: Sports Coaches are eligible for a consolidated salary of Rs. 55,000/- per month, and the salary will be commensurate to the candidate's qualification and experience. The candidate will not get any other benefits that are admissible to the University's regular employees.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online in the prescribed format by 21 November 2026. Then send the hard copy with self-attested documents to Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Central University of Rajasthan, NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, Distt – Ajmer (Raj.), PIN – 305817, so that it reaches the University by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the post of ……………… [Name of Post] (on contract basis)" on the envelope, with the name of the post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CURAJ Sports Coach posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at the University for an interview on the prescribed date and time. The University will publish the interview schedule separately on its website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CURAJ Sports Coach job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contractual basis for one year or till further orders, whichever is earlier. The engagement gives no right to claim a regular appointment or continued service in the University.
